material.heading: 240 grams. That is not a detail.
material.lede: Light t-shirts crumple by the third wash and the print cracks. Ours weigh 240 grams per square metre, the cotton is combed and ring-spun, and the collar has a double rib that holds its shape. The print is water-based screen print, which sinks into the fibre instead of sitting on top of it.

help.title: Help and contact
help.lede: The questions that come up most, with the actual answer rather than a sentence that circles it.

sections.h: How do I see my order
sections.p: With the order number and the email you used, on the "Find an order" page. No account is needed, and there is none to create: they are the two things that reached you by email the moment you paid.
We pack within two working days. In Italy delivery then takes two or three days, elsewhere in Europe three to six. We write with the tracking number when it leaves.
€5.90 in Italy, €9.90 elsewhere in the European Union, €19.90 outside it. Free everywhere over €120. The cost is in the summary from the first step of checkout, not at the end.
Yes, within thirty days of delivery. European law gives you fourteen: the thirty are our own choice. Returns are started from the order page, and within Italy they are free.

sections.h: How do I pick a size
sections.p: Every product page says how tall the model is and which size she wears, and reports how it fitted the people who bought it. The cut is straight with a dropped shoulder: size down if you want it close to the body.
By card, and with whatever methods Stripe offers in your country. Card details go from you to Stripe: this site never sees them and could not store them if it wanted to.
At ciao@lunaria.example, an address where a person answers. We reply within one working day.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lede: What actually happens to your data on this site, written without circling it.

sections.p: The cart stays in this browser until you clear it. What you type at checkout stays only for the length of the visit and is gone when you close the tab. If you use the account page, your name, address and order numbers stay in this browser until you press "Clear everything". None of it reaches us.

When you pay, the card details go straight to Stripe and never pass through this site. Along with the payment we send Stripe your name, email, shipping address and the list of garments: they are what makes the order and the receipt. Stripe is the processor for that part and has its own notice.

There is no analytics tool, no advertising pixel, no profiling cookie and no transfer to third parties beyond Stripe. The moon dates are calculated inside your browser: no data leaves the device for that.

sections.h: What a real shop must publish
sections.p: The controller with name and address, the legal basis for every processing operation, retention periods, the list of processors, transfers outside the European Union, how to exercise the rights under GDPR articles 15 to 22, and how to complain to the supervisory authority. These texts must be written and checked by a lawyer before selling.

cookie.title: Cookies
cookie.lede: One is ours and remembers which language you read in. The rest are Stripe's, set when you pay.

sections.p: It is called NEXT_LOCALE and holds two letters: it or en. We write it when you switch language, so coming back does not mean doing it again. It identifies nobody and says nothing about you beyond which of the two versions you prefer to read.
During payment Stripe sets its own, technical and anti-fraud. They are necessary for the payment to work and to spot an attempted fraud.

The cart, what you type at checkout and what the browser remembers of your account are not in a cookie: they are in local and session storage, which stay on the device and are not sent to any server with every request. There was also a cookie for the light or dark reading mode: that feature is gone, and if you still carry one we clear it on your next visit.

Because there is nothing to ask about. A cookie that remembers a language and a payment system's technical cookies need no consent: the law requires it for profiling, and there is none here. A banner that asks anyway is one more obstacle.
A real shop that adds analytics or advertising must publish the full list here with duration and purpose, and collect consent before installing them. This text must be checked by a lawyer.

recesso.title: Right of withdrawal
recesso.lede: Fourteen days are the law's. We give you thirty, and this is how it works.

sections.p: Thirty days from receiving the parcel to tell us you changed your mind, and another fourteen to send it back. You do not owe us a reason: we ask for one to learn what we get wrong, and you can leave it blank.
From your order page: pick the garments, pick the reason, and the site writes the message. We reply within one working day with the instructions. Writing to us directly works just as well.

sections.h: How it has to come back
sections.p: Whole, with the tag still on. You can try it the way you would try it in a shop: if it has actually been worn, taken out or washed, we cannot take it back.
Within Italy the return is free. From abroad the return is at your cost, except when the garment arrived faulty or wrong: then we pay either way.
Within fourteen days of the return reaching us, by the same means you paid with. We refund the outbound shipping too, up to the standard rate.

sections.h: The form and the legal references
sections.p: A real shop must publish here the downloadable model withdrawal form, the references to the consumer legislation that applies, the exceptions to the right of withdrawal, and the link to the European ODR platform. These texts must be written and checked by a lawyer before selling.

termini.title: Terms of sale
termini.lede: What holds when you buy here, and what is still missing.

sections.p: In euro, VAT included. Shipping appears in the summary before you pay, never after. When something is discounted, the lowest price we applied in the previous thirty days appears next to it, as the Omnibus directive requires.

When the payment succeeds and the confirmation with the order number reaches you. If a garment turns out to be gone after payment, we cancel that line and refund it: we do not send you something else instead.
Two years of legal conformity guarantee, as for any purchase from a professional seller in the European Union. It covers faults, not a size that does not fit: that is what withdrawal is for.
